addTrigger: Add the first trigger to turn it into a live workflow.
draftSaved: Draft saved. Add a default agent before enabling automation.
cannotMoveMany: Paperclip could not move the selected routines.
cannotSaveFolder: Paperclip could not save the folder.
cannotUpdateFolder: Paperclip could not update the folder.
cannotDeleteFolder: Paperclip could not delete the folder.
cannotMove: Paperclip could not move the routine.
cannotUpdate: Paperclip could not update the routine.
cannotRun: Paperclip could not start the routine run.
setAgent: Set a default agent before enabling routine automation.
selectOrg: Select an organization to view routines.
title: Title
noActive: No active routines. Use Create routine to define the first recurring workflow.
coalesce: If a run is already active, keep just one follow-up run queued.
enqueue: Queue every trigger occurrence, even if the routine is already running.
skipActive: Drop new trigger occurrences while a run is still active.
skipMissed: Ignore windows that were missed while the scheduler or routine was paused.
catchUp: Catch up missed schedule windows after recovery; sub-hourly schedules are combined into one catch-up run, slower schedules replay each missed window up to a cap.
